name: When should I replace my sliding door lock instead of repairing it?

mainEntity.name: When should I replace my sliding door lock instead of repairing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your sliding door lock when it's significantly damaged, corroded, or if components are missing, making a repair unreliable. If your lock frequently jams, no longer secures the door effectively, or if replacement parts are hard to find, a full replacement often provides better security and long-term functionality than a repair. A professional assessment can help determine the most cost-effective and secure solution for your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace a sliding door lock if it's significantly damaged, corroded, or frequently jams. A full replacement often offers better security and long-term function.
